title: Restore the widened LCLI-463 record rescued from the pre-purge history
description:
The rebuilt origin carries the NARROW version of LCLI-463 ("Decide whether lore scaffold docusaurus should pin its algolia search dependency versions", 3 acceptance criteria). A widening of that record never landed before the repository was deleted and rebuilt on 2026-09-10: it existed only on local branch chore/LCLI-463-widen-scope @ 5bcc30130f32783f7bd0f5d13f09a3f27ebfd38c, which git cherry confirmed was the ONLY one of 9 local branches with no patch-equivalent already in dev.

The widened record retitles it to "Decide which of this repo's CI-time external dependency fetches are worth pinning or caching" with 4 acceptance criteria, on the reasoning that three CI failures in one day — two npm/algolia resolution failures and one Chrome apt Hash Sum mismatch — are one exposure class (CI jobs resolving external dependencies fresh at run time from registries this repo does not control), not three separate incidents.

The content was archived BEFORE the reset to /Volumes/external/archive/lore-cli/pre-purge-unlanded-work/ — LCLI-463-widened.json plus NOTE.md, which records what it is, why it exists and the restore path. The branch itself was deleted with the other 8 as part of LCLI-468.

Only title, description and acceptanceCriteria differ from what origin already has; implementationNotes, labels and createdAt are unchanged. Restore with quest task edit so the record keeps an actor trail — do NOT hand-write .quest/tasks/LCLI-463.json, which CLAUDE.md forbids.

acceptanceCriteria.text: LCLI-463 carries the widened title, description and 4 acceptance criteria from the archived copy
The restore was applied via quest task edit with an explicit actor, not by writing the JSON record directly
The change is committed on the rebuilt history through a branch and PR per the SDLC, not left as an uncommitted working-tree edit
The archive directory and its NOTE.md are left in place as the provenance record
